smsTemplates.name: Official Turihamwe Plan Expiry Notice
smsTemplates.templateText: NYAMUYANJA SACCO nekumanyisa ku sente zawe za Turihamwe zihwireyo noshabwa kushashura obutarenzya ebiro mushanju (7) kuriga erizooba

auditLogs.newValue: Cleaned operational data and preserved exclusively authorized IT Officer (ivan) for production go-live.

charges.notes: Established Turihamwe charges: New registration UGX 25,000, Annual renewal UGX 20,000, Renewal after lapse UGX 25,000, Current benefit amount UGX 500,000.

contributionAmount.notes: Contributions must be recorded against a verified Turihamwe member plan as a positive monetary value in UGX without unapproved arbitrary limits. Staff enter actual amount and transaction date.

contributionFrequency.notes: Turihamwe operates strictly on an annual subscription cycle calculated from the member explicitly recorded subscription date.

planDuration.notes: Annual cover runs exactly one year (12 calendar months) from recorded subscription date without silent recalculation on view or edit.

gracePeriod.notes: Strictly prohibited: No 6-month grace period, no cover extension, no automatic cover continuation. Plans expire immediately on exact maturity date unless renewed.

alertSchedule.approvedMessageText: NYAMUYANJA SACCO nekumanyisa ku sente zawe za Turihamwe zihwireyo noshabwa kushashura obutarenzya ebiro mushanju (7) kuriga erizooba
alertSchedule.notes: Approved SMS reminder is scheduled and triggered automatically on the exact maturity date only. Advance reminder intervals (30d, 14d, 7d) are removed.

financialPenalties.notes: No automatic late fees, financial penalties, interest charges, or punitive monetary deductions are ever applied.

gracePeriodDays.notes: Grace period eliminated. Prompt annual renewal required on or before maturity date.

renewalCoverPeriodMonths.notes: Annual renewal extends cover for exactly 12 calendar months from the maturity date.

reactivationEligibility.notes: Renewal after expiry date requires reactivation fee of UGX 25,000 (standard renewal on or before expiry is UGX 20,000).

benefitAmountAndClaims.notes: Current benefit is UGX 500,000. Beneficiary death pays benefit to primary member without closing plan. Primary member death processes claim and closes plan.

membershipLimits.notes: No maximum limit on family members per plan. Former 13-member limit removed. Maximum beneficiary age 70 years (enforced by date of birth during enrollment; existing active members exempted). Permitted relationships strictly limited to: Biological Child, Biological Parent, and Spouse.

saccoAccountNumberPermanence.notes: A SACCO account number is a permanent institutional member record and has NO expiry date, NO time limitation, NO automatic deactivation, and NO restrictions based on Turihamwe subscription status. It remains valid indefinitely even if Turihamwe cover expires, is not renewed, or has zero transactions. Only Turihamwe welfare coverage has a maturity date.

claimQualifyingEvents.notes: Qualifying events: Death of Primary Member (burial support payout & plan closure) or Death of Registered Beneficiary (payout to member, plan remains active).

claimWaitingPeriodDays.notes: Waiting period from enrolment pending formal board policy ratification.

exclusionList: Beneficiaries exceeding age limit at time of first enrollment without existing plan

claimBenefitCalculation.benefitFormulaDescription: Fixed institutional benefit of UGX 500,000 per verified bereavement claim docket.
claimBenefitCalculation.notes: Standard benefit is UGX 500,000. Benefit increases require formal institutional approval and authorized configuration change.

claimFilingDeadlineDays.notes: Claim notification deadline pending board approval.

claimApprovalHierarchy.notes: Supervisory approval required (Branch Manager or GM) enforcing separation of duties from claim preparer.

notificationTiming.notes: Exact maturity date notification (Day 0) with 7-day payment window notice text. Advance 30d/14d/7d intervals removed.

eligibilityRules.notes: Member savings minimums pending formal board ratification.

claimRequirements.notes: Mandatory documentation specifications required for claim docket verification.
